metadata.title: Clicked like a confused cat and somehow stole a kill? Valorant logic is wild again
metadata.description:
Me: spazzing on my mouse like it’s a magic trick
Enemy: probably uninstalling from confusion
How did I even land that shot? No clue, but I’ll take it
Click if your worst aim surprises you too!

Tap if your panic clicks ever shock even you!
